zh.title: 波音737 MAX 7即將獲得FAA最終批准
zh.summary: 西南航空長時間等待波音737 MAX 7，因其商業模式全依賴單一機隊。
body: 根據Simple Flying的報導，西南航空已經等待較久的時間才能取得波音737 MAX 7的交付。
該報導指出，西南航空的整個商業模式圍繞單一機隊展開，使得此型機對其未來十年的運營至關重要。
目前波音737 MAX 7正接近獲得美國聯邦航空局（FAA）的最終批准。

en.title: Boeing 737 MAX 7 Nears FAA Approval as Southwest Airlines Relies on Single Fleet
en.summary: Southwest Airlines has been waiting longer than ever for the Boeing 737 MAX 7, as its entire business model revolves around a single aircraft fleet.
body: According to Simple Flying, Southwest Airlines has endured an extended wait for the Boeing 737 MAX 7.
The article notes that Southwest's whole business model is built around operating a single aircraft type, making the MAX 7 crucial for its next decade of operations.
Boeing 737 MAX 7 is presently approaching final approval from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

zh.title: Simple Flying發布達美空服員關門前三十分鐘薪資分析
zh.summary: Simple Flying於二零二六年七月二十六日發布報導，標題為《達美空服員關門前三十分鐘薪資實況》，文中指出達美成為首家解決長期薪資糾紛的航空公司。該文章詳細分析了關門前三十分鐘的薪資結構，並引述公司內部文件說明新政策的實施細節。
body: Simple Flying於二零二六年七月二十六日發布報導，標題為《達美空服員關門前三十分鐘薪資實況》，摘要指出達美成為首家解決長期薪資糾紛的航空公司。
文章詳細分析關門前三十分鐘的薪資結構，並引述公司內部文件說明新政策實施細節，比較新薪資與舊合約差異，強調對排班與士氣的影響。

en.title: Simple Flying publishes analysis of Delta flight attendant pay before door close
en.summary: Simple Flying published an article on 26 July 2026 titled "How Much A Delta Air Lines Flight Attendant Actually Earns During The 30 Minutes Before Door Close." The analysis also compares the new pay rates with previous contracts and highlights the impact on crew scheduling and morale.
